prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in League City, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1353; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, but you can use the claim reference you have on file.

Q: That works. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was driving on the highway in League City, in the right lane, heading toward the exit for the shopping center.

Q: What were you doing right before the impact?

A: I was changing lanes to move over for the exit. I checked my mirror and glanced over my shoulder, and I didn't see anything close. I started to move over and then there was a loud bang on my passenger side.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before contact?

A: No. It came from my blind spot. I think it was in the lane I was moving into, but I didn't see it until it hit my car.

Q: Were you able to stop, or did your car keep moving?

A: I braked and pulled onto the shoulder. The car spun a little and then stopped against the guardrail.

Q: Did you get out of the vehicle or receive any medical attention at the scene?

A: I got out, but I felt dizzy and had a headache. Someone called for an ambulance. They checked me and told me I might have a concussion.

Q: Have you been diagnosed with a concussion by a physician?

A: Yes. I had a follow-up visit, and the doctor confirmed a concussion. I've been told to rest and avoid screens for a while, and I still get headaches when I read for long periods.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I was following the rules of the road and I'm still dealing with the effects of the injury.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
